scope: single-run exploratory REVIEWER probe; not evaluator_selection_v1 and not a production adjudication

authorization.service: Z.ai/BigModel China standard API via Pi custom provider
authorization.basis: The user's 2026-08-27 request explicitly asked to test pi/z.ai cn/GLM 5.3 Flash and then supplied a custom provider for the route.
authorization.data_scope: existing frozen B4 source/target reviewer sample only

prompt.adjustment: Only the required item count was mechanically changed from 21 to 24.

output_schema.enforcement: Pi has no JSON-schema CLI flag; the unchanged schema is enforced by the local post-inference validator.

route.harness: pi 0.84.3 print mode with JSON event stream
route.provider_config_origin: user-managed global Pi models.json; credential value is not copied into this experiment
route.cost_metadata: not configured on the custom model, so Pi reports zero cost; this is not evidence that the service call was free

decision_rule.candidate_label: DEFECT when observation is not exactly OK; CLEAN when observation is exactly OK
decision_rule.reference_label: DEFECT when verdict/decision is defect; CLEAN otherwise
decision_rule.valid_candidate: strict JSON, exact schema, exactly 24 revisions in frozen input order
decision_rule.qualification: single run; compare descriptively with recorded B4 baseline runs but do not infer variance or production fitness
